value.rationale: Cross-immunity is an explicit intermediate epidemiological class. Simultaneously accelerating its entry and exit produces competing flux effects whose sign is not determined by rising infection. The sharp μβ/δγ threshold and exact optimum identify when the state accumulates before disappearing under stronger immune escape, a motivated mechanism not just a numerical rate substitution.
